title: Lockup: Sacramento: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Purple Pain
Deputies respond to a possible gang beating, but the surveillance cameras don't catch anything; a wounded warrior faces a new battle when he and his girlfriend both get arrested.

title: Lockup: Charleston: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Fatality
A fight breaks out over snacks, but officers want to know if there was something else behind it; an open transgender inmate, who "escorts" on the street, chooses general population over protective custody; an inmate is found dead in his bunk.

title: Lockup: Louisville: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Lightning Voltz
The Louisville Metro Department of Corrections Jail has a daily population of about 2,000 men and women charged with anything from minor crimes to capital murder; both buildings are overcrowded, and their layouts are outdated.

title: Lockup: San Quentin: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Slammin' in the Slammer
At San Quentin, every inmate is marked with a security level based on his crime and prison behavior; serving as a reception center, the overpopulated prison must house a dangerous mix of levels within proximity of one another.

title: Lockup: San Antonio: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Love Sick
An inmate with an influential family in one gang, joins its arch rival; a female inmate who has ties to both gangs finds her mail has jail officials concerned.

title: Lockup Special Investigation
description:
S1 E6 — Lake County Juvenile Justice: Michael, Ricardo, Miguel
Ricky has spent a total of 266 days in Lake County, and another 16 months at a residential placement facility in Nevada; when he didn't return to his placement in Nevada after a weekend home pass, Ricky was picked up on a bench warrant.

title: Lockup: Orange County: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Murders and Miracles
One inmate launches a near fatal attack after being in jail for less than an hour; a father accused of murdering his daughter admits to keeping her corpse with him for two years; a female inmate keeps a grim secret from her two best friends.

title: Lockup: Indiana: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Brotherhood
Using a form of integration at Indiana State that goes beyond race, the Residential Treatment Unit selects inmates with a history of good behavior to live with and serve as mentors to inmates with mental health issues.

title: Lockup: Cincinnati: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Sucker Punch
After an inmate is assaulted, the jail identifies a suspect, but the violence doesn't stop there; a young inmate gets a crash course on how to survive in jail, as he prepares to deal with the consequences of his actions.

title: Lockup: Wabash: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — We Fight
Indiana's Wabash Valley Correctional Facility is an isolated fortress with three officers for every 200 inmates; some inmates find themselves in racial conflict, while others seek conflict elsewhere.

title: Lockup: Tulsa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Two Degrees of Murder
A pregnant woman faces the charge of killing her husband two months away from giving birth; her future lies in the hands of a judge; another inmate, also facing a murder charge, pays a price when he disobeys orders.

title: Lockup: San Antonio: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Words of a Warrior
A two-on-one assault leaves an inmate bloodied and injured, but getting to the bottom of this fight requires some digging; a popular restaurateur, accused of capitol murder, fights for his freedom.

title: Lockup: San Antonio: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — A House Divided
Former gang members attempt to leave deadly rivalries behind, then the men in another housing unit deal with a completely different set of issues; a surprise contraband raid turns one housing unit upside down.

title: Lockup: Cleveland: Extended Stay
description:
S16 E1 — Heartless Felons
Life inside the Cuyahoga County Correction Center; members of the jail's most predatory gang set their sights on vulnerable prey; an inmate suffers an apparent breakdown.

title: Lockup: San Antonio: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Carry That Weight
An inmate causes chaos in his housing unit after accusing staff of abusing him, and he explodes in anger when a valued possession is taken from his cell; accused of a vicious vigilante-style murder, another inmate says jail has saved his own life.
